summary: Phase 59 Master Delivery Report covering live service integration, enterprise email operations, recovery security, and institutional acceptance. Validates 30/30 Phase 59 test items (TEST-P59-01 through TEST-P59-30), 706/706 master platform tests, evidence-backed provider verification (8 exact states), recovery rollback mechanism, lockfile protection, 10-mailbox inventory, 5-dimensional authorization model, OAuth PKCE, controlled pilot safety gates, enterprise operations monitoring API, PostgreSQL 6-state persistence, and VAWA Section 1367 confidential safeguarding isolation.
